headline: Junior Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with experience delivering 100+ digital and print creatives, brand identities, and visual systems.

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding and visual identity, typography, layout, print production, social/marketing creative

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Managed print-ready file preparation including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders to execute design briefs within low revision cycles.

experience.title: UI/UX & Visual Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses and startups.
Developed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for SMBs.
Utilized Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design execution.

projects.name: Social Campaign for Fashion Brand
bullets: Created an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Designed comprehensive logo, typography, and color palette guidelines.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her strong execution in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop from Ascent Business Solutions, emphasizing her high-volume collateral and brand identity work to match Subko's visual design requirements.
omitted: AI-assisted workflows (omitted to focus entirely on core graphic design software and output as requested by the posting)
Bounceless B2B UX case study (omitted because this role is strictly for a graphic designer, not a UX/product designer)
UX process work like wireframing and usability testing (omitted as irrelevant to a purely graphic design role)
